create_random_video_dataset: create a RandomVideoDataset instance with configurable num_classes, split, num_samples, frames_per_clip, video dimensions, audio_samples, and clips_per_video
getitem_random_video_sample: get a random video sample with video tensor and audio tensor by indexing into a RandomVideoDataset
len_random_video_dataset: get the total number of samples in a RandomVideoDataset by calling len on the dataset instance
test_random_video_dataset: test a RandomVideoDataset by iterating over samples and verifying video and audio tensor shapes and target labels
review_random_video_dataset: review the RandomVideoDataset class to understand how it generates random video and audio data with seeded targets per split
